title: Los verbos de cambio ponerse y quedarse
goal: Master verbs of becoming 'ponerse' and 'quedarse' to express sudden emotional reactions and resulting states.
grammar: verbos de cambio ponerse y quedarse: reacciones anímicas y estados resultantes

items: Deploy 'ponerse' with emotional and physical adjectives for temporary reactions.
Utilize 'quedarse' to emphasize the final resulting condition or deprivation.
Distinguish between voluntary decisions and involuntary states.
